title: Space Rock
style: Melodic Hard Rock:1.4), (AOR:1.3), (80s Arena Rock Revival). BPM: 124. Vibe: Uplifting, Romantic, Energetic, Polish. Instruments: Bright analog synthesizer hooks (Oberheim style), driving palm-muted electric guitars, melodic bassline, massive snare with gated reverb. Vocals: Male, High Tenor, clean tone with moments of grit, passionate and soaring delivery. Features: [Catchy Keyboard Intro], [Power Chord Progressions], [Layered Vocal Harmonies in Chorus], [Melodic Shred Guitar Solo]. Structure: Intro, Verse, Pre-Chorus, Explosive Chorus, Verse, Bridge, Solo, Final Chorus, Outro. Production: Crystal clear, studio quality.
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Bright, gated synth arpeggio fades in, followed by a massive, gated reverb snare hit and a power chord swell)

[Verse 1]
We’re riding low beneath the red line of the dreadnought fleet
The hull is screaming, every shockwave rattles through my seat
They track our vector, six long hours since we broke the siege
But you’re the co-pilot, girl, and failure is not our creed
I see the fire in your eyes reflected on the screen
A thousand stars are burning out, but we still hold the dream

[Verse 2]
The fuel gauge drops below the point of no return tonight
We left the gravity of fear and chased the fading light
They call us pirates, call us traitors to the old regime
But all we want is freedom, powered by a future dream
I feel your pulse beneath my hand upon the throttle grip
If we go down, we go down fast, aboard this lonely ship

[Pre-Chorus]
Just one more system, baby, calculate the jump coordinates
I’m pushing power, hear the cry of the twin reactor vents
We’ve got to break the atmosphere before the laser strikes
Engage the drive, turn off the lights!

[Chorus 1]
We are the runaways! Chasing the cosmic dawn!
Burning the bridges of the life we left behind and gone!
Hyperdrive Heartbeat! Across the void we fly!
Searching for Eden on a planet hidden in the sky!
We’ll find our haven, where the shadows never fall!
We’re breaking free, we’re gonna risk it all!

[Verse 3]
The scanners clear, we bought a moment in the asteroid field
The enemy is fractured, but they never truly yield
The engine’s humming low and deep, a battle weary sound
We check the charts for Kepler 186-F ground
You lean across the console, wipe the stardust from my face
We’re the last hope for a new start, escaping time and space

[Hook 1]
(Guitar riff answers the vocal line)
Punch it hard! Set the course for X-7!
One chance left to touch the gates of heaven!

[Bridge]
We know the sacrifice that brought us to this burning edge
We traded comfort for the promise written on this ledge
When the gate opens and the starlight finally shines so bright
We’ll plant our flag upon that world and claim the endless night
Hold on tight, my love, don't let the darkness pull us down
We're nearly there, outside the boundaries of this wicked town

[Solo]
(Melodic Shred Guitar Solo featuring fast arpeggios, heavy vibrato, and soaring bends, backed by massive power chords and a dramatic Oberheim synth counter-melody)

[Chorus 2]
We are the runaways! Chasing the cosmic dawn!
Burning the bridges of the life we left behind and gone!
Hyperdrive Heartbeat! Across the void we fly!
Searching for Eden on a planet hidden in the sky!
We’ll find our haven, where the shadows never fall!
We’re breaking free, we’re gonna risk it all!

[Instrumental]
(Section focuses on the main keyboard hook played over driving, palm-muted guitars and heavy gated snare fills.)

[Drop]
(The rhythm simplifies, massive synth bass hits pulse rapidly, the gated reverb on the snare becomes even more exaggerated. Vocals are minimal shouts.)
(Male, gritty vocal) GO! NOW! PUSH! THE! LIMIT!

[Interlude]
(Sound of heavy breathing and static radio chatter. Music drops to a single sustained synth pad.)
*Male, whispered:* We made it. Look... look at the blue.

[Outro]
(The main AOR riff returns, triumphant and slightly slower. The sound of the ship successfully entering a new atmosphere. Fade out on the synth melody and the final, massive gated reverb snare hit.)
Yeah! We’re home!
(Synth fades to silence)
